name: Full MIS in Bidirectional Path Tracing
aliases: Bidirectional Path Tracing (BPT) with Full MIS
Bidirectional Path Tracing with Full MIS
Full MIS in Bidirectional Path Tracing — BPT with Full MIS, Full Path PDF MIS
definition: A method for Bidirectional Path Tracing (BPT) that uses full path pdfs incorporating medium sampling to weight MIS combinations, improving quality over directional MIS which only uses directional real-scattering pdfs.
summary: Full MIS in Bidirectional Path Tracing computes exact path PDFs including medium sampling to improve accuracy in dense participating media.
